relationships: Interfaces feed the deterministic control plane.
EXECUTE dispatches bounded work into execution domains.
Execution domains use the host, CUDA, and multimodal runtime substrates.
Runtime and domain activity produce durable state, lineage, run records, and receipts.
Durable evidence flows back into EVALUATE and OBSERVE.
DECIDE applies evidence and policy to promotion, rejection, quarantine, or rollback.
Remote peers remain bounded execution adapters and do not own control.
rendering_constraints: Keep the five numbered layers visually distinct and aligned.
Preserve the eight-stage control plane as the dominant left-to-right sequence.
Use orthogonal connectors with visible arrowheads.
Terminate the EXECUTE connector at the distribution bus between layers 2 and 3; do not extend it through the bus.
Terminate the upward evidence connector exactly at the bottom border of OBSERVE.
Terminate module connectors at box borders without crossing those borders.
Keep control, evidence, and policy paths visually distinct.
Do not imply that remote peers own control-plane state.
Do not imply that every execution domain supports every modality.
Keep all labels legible at approximately 1200 pixels display width.
Do not add claims that are not represented in the repository.
Treat this JSON as the editable semantic specification and the PNG as its reviewed rendering.
